filing_fee_notes: Base domestic LLC formation fee; annual reporting and tax obligations are separate.
registered_agent_rules: Continuously maintain a consenting Kentucky resident individual, Kentucky entity or authorized foreign entity as registered agent at a Kentucky street address.
annual_report_due: January 1 through June 30 each year, beginning the calendar year after formation.
franchise_or_privilege_tax: Limited Liability Entity Tax generally applies to LLCs, subject to statutory exemptions. The minimum is 175; larger businesses calculate liability using Kentucky gross receipts or gross profits.
plain_english_summary: File Articles of Organization and maintain a Kentucky registered agent. File annual reports and check the separate entity-tax obligation.
common_mistake: Assuming the annual-report fee pays the Limited Liability Entity Tax.
notes: Standard domestic LLC fee recorded. The cited Secretary of State formation instructions describe the general registered-agent and first-report rules. Formation processing time, expedite options, publication and operating-agreement requirement were not confirmed and are null. Report URL is the official filing gateway.
